title: Scalar Finite-Proper-Time Field Theory as a Complete-History Spectral Calculus
summary: We formulate a finite-proper-time (FPT) construction for real scalar $λφ^4$ theory in which a non-zero lower endpoint $s_0$ is retained as physical spectral data for complete virtual histories. Functional differentiation partitions a pre-existing history, while interaction sewing creates closed momentum circulations.
